# Two steps

Version 1\.0\.0 · VERIFIED · chained

Lists the processes of an endpoint\, then lists them again once it is done\.

## Steps

### 1\. Step 1 \- list processes

- Starts when the scenario is launched.
- Injector: openaev\_implant
- Payload: Process Discovery \- ps \(00000000\-0000\-4000\-8000\-00000000000c\)

Command (sh):

```
ps aux --no-headers
```

### 2\. Step 2 \- list processes again

- Waits for: step 1.
- Injector: openaev\_implant
- Payload: Process Discovery \- ps \(00000000\-0000\-4000\-8000\-00000000000c\)

Command (sh):

```
ps aux --no-headers
```
